challenge: Keep sources stable between fixture freeze, worker execution and replay.
context: During offline v4.1 preparation, the source-frozen integration suite was still running when a source error-message was edited. Initial run: 137 passed/one failed. Failure raised Running implementation differs from frozen repository in the overflow replay test.

evidence.note: Observed mismatch and stable isolated/full reruns are recorded; existing source mutation tests preserve refusal behavior. No new inference or relaxed policy.

limitations: Local engineering process incident, not a provider or model quality failure.
Passing stable tests does not prove real model improvement or remove INC-0031 failures.
resolution: Treat source mutations and source-frozen test execution as sequential dependencies. Finish edits before creating/running fixtures; repeat affected fixtures only after diagnosing the mismatch. Keep source verification unchanged.
root_cause: The running test copied and froze source files before an edit; replay compared them with later runtime source bytes and correctly refused the mismatch. Editing source while a source-bound suite runs invalidates that fixture.
summary: One integrated fixture replay correctly rejected different runtime/source bytes after an error-message edit during the suite. Isolated stable rerun and subsequent complete stable suite passed without weakening source gates. Process incident only; no model call or product-policy bypass.
